# EuroRust

EuroRust is an annual conference for the European Rust community. EuroRust 2027 takes place in Prague, Czechia, from October 14–17, 2027.

## Current event

- [EuroRust 2027](https://eurorust.eu/): Dates, past speakers, past sponsors, and newsletter signup.
- [Tickets](https://eurorust.eu/tickets/): Current ticket availability.
- [Code of Conduct](https://eurorust.eu/code-of-conduct/): Participation and conduct requirements.
- [Privacy](https://eurorust.eu/privacy/): Privacy policy.
- [Email EuroRust](mailto:mail@eurorust.eu): Contact the organizers.

## Previous editions

- [EuroRust 2026](https://eurorust.eu/2026/): Barcelona conference archive.
- [EuroRust 2026 event guide](https://eurorust.eu/2026/llms.txt): Archived talks, workshops, activities, and attendee information.
- [EuroRust 2025](https://eurorust.eu/2025/)
- [EuroRust 2024](https://eurorust.eu/2024/)
- [EuroRust 2023](https://eurorust.eu/2023/)
- [EuroRust 2022](https://eurorust.eu/2022/)
